== Summary ==
[[Bruce Umene]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]], doing the macarena. Crop of [[:File:Bruce Umene DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] (the man in glasses at far left, pointing). Photo: Decipher. See [[Bruce Umene]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Decipher fri30 caption "Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene does the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs." Umene is the man at far left pointing his finger (Bill Bisco, 25 October 2026). The first version of this crop (25 October 2026) showed the standing man in the black shirt left of centre, who is [[Jim Colson]], [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 5.
